The solution splits `s` into consecutive pairs `(s[2i], s[2i+1])`. Each mismatched pair needs exactly one change, and matched pairs can be merged into even-length uniform blocks, so the answer is the number of mismatched pairs. I checked each expected output by hand against this rule.

```json
[
  {"input": "\"11\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"01\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"1100\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"1010\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"000111\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"110011\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"101010\"", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "\"0110\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"111000\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"10000001\"", "output": "2"}
]
```

The solution splits the string into consecutive pairs `(s[0],s[1])`, `(s[2],s[3])`, and so on. Each mismatched pair needs exactly one change, and matched pairs need none, so the answer is the number of mismatched pairs. I checked the outputs by hand with this rule.

```json
[
  {"input": "\"11\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"01\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"1111\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"0110\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"100011\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"1010\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"000111\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"1100\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"101010\"", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "\"1000000000\"", "output": "1"}
]
```

The minimum number of changes equals the number of length-2 blocks (starting at even indices) whose two characters differ. Any even-length block of identical characters can be split into pairs of equal characters, so each mismatched pair needs exactly one change. For example, "1001" has pairs "10" and "01", both mismatched, giving 2.

```json
[
  {"input": "\"11\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"01\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"1100\"", "output": "0"},
  {"input": "\"101010\"", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "\"0110\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"10001110\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"11110110\"", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "\"0101010101\"", "output": "5"},
  {"input": "\"100000\"", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "\"000111\"", "output": "1"}
]
```
